description: The one-shot call that creates the first team and its first admin on a freshly deployed hub, before any member is able to log in.
auth: The X-Bootstrap-Token header must equal the Worker secret BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN

headers.X-Bootstrap-Token: <the value stored as the BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN secret>

notes: The endpoint only accepts a call while the teams table is empty; a second call answers 409 CONFLICT with the existing team id, so the first success is what retires it and no separate switch exists.

email is resolved through the account service admin lookup into the account_user_id the members table requires, creating an active admin member row already bound to that account; the legacy github_username field is no longer accepted (answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED).

Failure branches: an email unknown to the account service answers 404 USER_NOT_FOUND (prompting the user to sign in to the Whale app with Apple once before running bootstrap); an unreachable or unexpected account service answers 502 ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE; a hub missing BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN, ACCOUNT_SERVICE_BASE, or ACCOUNT_ADMIN_TOKEN answers 503 NOT_CONFIGURED; a missing or invalid X-Bootstrap-Token header answers 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
The member is written as role admin with status active, which is what lets it reach every admin endpoint without an invite.
The team and its member are written in one transaction, so a hub never holds a team whose admin row is missing.
